title: Design, synthesis, and cytotoxic evaluation of quinazoline-based derivatives as VEGER-2 inhibitors: comparative study against EGFR kinase activity, induction of apoptosis, and molecular docking study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29593-29612
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03829D, Paper

Reda R. Mabrouk, Arafa Musa, Maged Mohammed Saleh Al Ward, Shaimaa Hussein, Ahmed K. B. Aljohani, Mohamed Ayman El-Zahabi, Alaa Elwan
A novel series of quinazoline-based compounds were designed and synthesized as modified analogues to certain known VEGFR-2 inhibitors, as an extension of our work on the design and synthesis of new VEGFR-2 inhibitors.
